what_this_is: Every family parked in the Dormant pool: frozen spec, entry-time autocorrelation bucket, point-in-time and rescorability flags. POPULATED 2026-09-09 from the owner-signed triage, by populate_dormant_manifest.py, which measured every field (frozen spec, window end matched to the persisted observation count, entry-time autocorrelation, pre-entry drift) rather than asserting it. Excluded families and their reasons are in dormant_pool_manifest.staged.json and POPULATE_REPORT.md. See app/services/research_lab/dormant_pool.py for the fields and the rule.
